definitions.scope: campaigns with 100 or more contestants (counts from the export or the contestant dump), plausible dates, organizer country from IP; every row needs five organizers
definitions.skill_signal_share: share of campaigns whose name, incentive text, custom terms or selection method mention a judged or skill entry (25 words or less, game of skill, judged, best answer, most creative and similar)
definitions.judged_selection_share: share whose generated terms name a judged, skill, best-answer or vote selection
definitions.action_*: share of campaigns offering that action family
definitions.terms_by_country: shares of campaigns whose custom terms or incentive description contain each wording family, plus generated-terms settings; governing_law_named_other_country_share is a rough mismatch flag
